fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Raman and I live at 340 Linden Court, Ashland, OR 97577. You can reach me on (555) 915-9778 or dmitri.raman@example.com. On 1 October 2024 the Ashwater River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00109. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Raman on (555) 915-9778 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 1 October 2024.
Site visit to 340 Linden Court. Neighbour Ethan Moreau was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
